normalized.result: Yes, this is exactly how I want to check things off. Marking the roast potatoes article as read took it out of my Read later pile — now showing one article waiting — moved it into Finished, and it's still counted among all four bookmarks rather than being thrown away. That matters to me: reading something shouldn't delete it. And the little "Moved to Finished — Undo" gives me a safety net if I tap it by mistake.
